## Profile

Software Engineer with over 7 years of experience building scalable, fault-tolerant systems for Fintech, Healthcare, and SaaS. Core stack: Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and PostgreSQL. Takes ownership of the entire product lifecycle — from architecting cloud infrastructure to developing mobile apps and integrating AI into real-world business features.

Strong advocate for clean code, automated processes, and pragmatic architectural decisions that drive a product forward. Systems ship with automated tests (Testcontainers) and full production observability (OpenTelemetry, Grafana) from day one.

## Services & Expertise

### Backend Engineering
Designing high-throughput, scalable, microservices- and event-driven architectures with measurable SLOs. Built on event-driven architecture and measurable SLOs. Technologies: Java (up to Java 21), Spring Boot, Kotlin, Go, Python.

### AI Integration
Implementing LLMs, RAG architectures, and autonomous agents into production. Expertise in deploying local AI models (on-premise) to ensure strict data privacy, security, and non-disclosure. Technologies: Spring AI, MCP, RAG, Local LLMs / Ollama, LLM APIs.

### Cloud & DevOps
Cloud architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure-as-Code on AWS for maximum scalability, observability, and safe releases. Technologies: AWS / EKS, Terraform, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry.

### Fullstack & Mobile
End-to-end product development from scratch — covering database design, robust APIs, modern web applications (Angular), and cross-platform mobile solutions (Flutter). Technologies: Angular, Flutter, Kotlin, REST / gRPC, PostgreSQL, Firebase.

## Selected Case Studies

1. **Cloud Billing SaaS** (Backend) — Architected and delivered a high-throughput invoicing pipeline with high availability. Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS. Role: Lead Backend Engineer.
2. **Modular Payments Platform** (Backend) — Integrated multiple payment providers featuring an automated failover mechanism and real-time analytics. Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, AWS, PostgreSQL. Role: Lead Backend Engineer.
3. **Real-Time Collaboration Service** (Backend) — Developed low-latency synchronization for concurrent document editing by multiple users. Stack: Java, Spring Boot, WebSocket, Redis. Role: Lead Backend Developer.
4. **Healthcare Integration Suite** (Backend) — Ensured secure medical-device integration in strict compliance with US medical-device standards (Class B). Stack: Java, Spring, Cassandra, gRPC. Role: Backend Developer.
5. **eCommerce Admin Toolkit** (Fullstack) — Built an API-first administrative panel to manage catalogs, orders, and customer analytics. Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, Angular, PostgreSQL. Role: Fullstack Developer.
6. **Wellness Tracker App** (Mobile) — Created and launched a cross-platform mobile application with cloud synchronization and push notifications on iOS and Android. Stack: Flutter, Firebase, REST. Role: Project Owner & Developer.
